summary.en: The transparent cornea admits and bends incoming light.
summary.zh: 透明的角膜让光进入，并使光折射。

detail.en:
The cornea is the curved transparent surface at the front of the eye, ahead of the iris and lens. It works with the lens to focus incoming light. [S2]

This clear shell is an original cutaway schematic. Its thickness and curvature are design choices; the separate optical bench combines the cornea and lens into one effective lens. [S31]
detail.zh:
角膜是眼睛前端弯曲、透明的表面，位于虹膜和晶状体之前。它与晶状体一起使入眼的光聚焦。[S2]

这里的透明薄壳是原创剖面示意，厚度与曲率是设计值。另一个光学工位把角膜与晶状体合成一个有效透镜。[S31]

summary.en: The iris controls the size of the opening called the pupil.
summary.zh: 虹膜调节称为瞳孔的开口大小。

detail.en:
The iris lies behind the cornea and in front of the lens. The pupil is its opening, not a solid black part. Changing that opening changes how much light can enter. [S2]

Select this fixed outer rim to inspect the iris. Two non-selectable annular inserts show the two model apertures with the same outer diameter and a twofold change of inner diameter. They are discrete schematic states, not a muscle simulation or a measurement of a child’s pupil. [S31]
detail.zh:
虹膜位于角膜后、晶状体前。瞳孔是虹膜中的开口，不是一块黑色实物。开口大小改变，能进入的光量也随之改变。[S2]

可选中的这一圈是虹膜的固定外缘。两张不可选中的环形薄片表示两档模型孔径；外径相同，内径相差两倍。这是离散示意状态，不是肌肉模拟，也不是儿童瞳孔测量。[S31]

summary.en: The lens changes shape to help focus at different distances.
summary.zh: 晶状体改变形状，帮助眼睛看清不同距离。

detail.en:
The lens sits behind the iris, held around its edge by fibres connected to the ciliary body. The cornea and lens together focus light toward the retina. [S2, S3]

During near viewing the lens becomes rounder; during far viewing it is flatter. These two biconvex shapes illustrate that change without claiming a measured focal length or quantitative tissue deformation. [S3, S31]
detail.zh:
晶状体位于虹膜之后，周缘由连接睫状体的纤维悬持。角膜与晶状体共同把光聚向视网膜。[S2, S3]

看近处时晶状体更圆鼓，看远处时较扁。这里的两种双凸形状只说明这一变化，不表示真实焦距或组织变形量。[S3, S31]

summary.en: The ciliary apparatus changes the tension holding the lens.
summary.zh: 睫状装置改变悬持晶状体的张力。

detail.en:
The ciliary body surrounds the lens and connects to it through suspensory fibres. Changes in muscle action and fibre tension allow the lens to change shape. [S3]

The ring and a few radial fibres are enlarged schematic landmarks. The number of fibres drawn is not an anatomical count, and their movement is not calculated here. [S31]
detail.zh:
睫状体环绕晶状体，通过悬韧带与它相连。肌肉活动和纤维张力的变化，使晶状体能改变形状。[S3]

环与少量放射纤维是便于辨认的放大示意。画出的纤维数不代表解剖总数，这里也不计算纤维运动。[S31]

summary.en: The sclera forms the tough outer wall of the eyeball.
summary.zh: 巩膜构成眼球坚韧的外壁。

detail.en:
The sclera is the outer coat surrounding most of the eyeball. At the front, the transparent cornea takes its place. The retina lines the inside of the back region. [S24]

This hollow shell is opened toward the viewer to expose the inside. It is not an empty solid sphere. X-ray changes this outer shell while leaving internal structures readable; dimensions are schematic. [S31]
detail.zh:
巩膜包围眼球的大部分，形成外层壁；眼球前端则是透明的角膜。后部内壁的里面衬着视网膜。[S24]

这是一层中空外壳，朝观察者的一面打开，以露出内部。它不是一颗实心球。透视时主要降低外壳的不透明度，使内层仍可辨认；尺寸均为示意。[S31]

summary.en: The vitreous is the clear gel filling the space behind the lens.
summary.zh: 玻璃体是填充晶状体后方空间的透明胶状物。

detail.en:
The vitreous occupies the large space between the lens and retina. It is a transparent gel rather than air. [S24]

A translucent volume distinguishes the filling from the surrounding thin layers. Its open front and low opacity make the retina visible; the shape and displayed transparency are design choices. [S31]
detail.zh:
玻璃体位于晶状体与视网膜之间的大部分空间内，是透明胶状物，不是空气。[S24]

这里用半透明的体积把填充物与周围薄层区分开。前方打开并降低不透明度，让视网膜可以看见；形状和透明程度是显示设计。[S31]

summary.en: The retina receives light and starts electrical signalling.
summary.zh: 视网膜接收光，并启动电信号传递。

detail.en:
The retina is a thin light-sensitive layer at the back inside the eye. Rod and cone cells help convert incoming light into electrical activity. [S2, S24]

This thin lining follows the inside wall; it is not a second eyeball. Individual receptor distributions and the later processing of vision in the brain are omitted. Light rays stop at the receiver in the separate bench; nerve paths show signals. [S31]
detail.zh:
视网膜是眼球内部后方的一层薄薄的感光组织，其中的视杆细胞和视锥细胞帮助把入射光转成电活动。[S2, S24]

这里的薄层贴着内壁，不是另一个眼球。模型没有画感光细胞分布，也没有模拟脑内的视觉处理。另一个工位的光线止于接收面，神经路径表示信号。[S31]

summary.en: The optic nerve carries visual signals toward the brain.
summary.zh: 视神经把视觉信号传向大脑。

detail.en:
The optic nerve leaves the back of the eye and carries electrical signals from the retina toward the brain. Light does not continue along the nerve. [S2]

The bundled tube and moving markers are schematic. The displayed speed is for reading the route, not a measured nerve conduction speed, and the brain lies outside this model. [S31]
detail.zh:
视神经从眼球后部离开，把来自视网膜的电信号传向大脑。光不会沿视神经继续前进。[S2]

束状管与移动标记都是示意。显示速度只为看清路径，不表示神经传导速度；大脑位于模型之外。[S31]

summary.en: The pinna helps collect sound toward the ear canal.
summary.zh: 耳廓帮助把声音汇入外耳道。

detail.en:
The pinna is the visible outer flap of the ear. Its folds lead toward the entrance of the ear canal; it is only one part of the ear. [S7]

This single-ear schematic uses an original outer rim and inner fold. Fine skin anatomy and personal differences are omitted, and this station is enlarged independently from the eye. [S31]
detail.zh:
耳廓是从外面看得见的耳部，褶皱通向外耳道入口。它只是耳朵的一部分。[S7]

这一只耳的示意由原创外缘与内侧褶皱组成，省略皮肤细节和个体差异。它与眼睛工位分别放大，不共用真实比例。[S31]

summary.en: The ear canal guides sound vibration to the eardrum.
summary.zh: 外耳道把声音振动传到鼓膜。

detail.en:
The ear canal runs inward from the pinna and ends at the eardrum. It does not continue through the middle ear into the cochlea. [S7]

The open U-shaped wall exposes the air passage in this longitudinal cut. Its shortened path is a display choice; do not put objects into the ear canal. [S18, S31]
detail.zh:
外耳道从耳廓向内延伸，止于鼓膜，并不会穿过中耳一直通到耳蜗。[S7]

纵切示意用打开的U形壁露出通道，路径为展示而缩短。不要把物品伸入外耳道。[S18, S31]

summary.en: The eardrum vibrates when sound reaches the end of the canal.
summary.zh: 声音到达外耳道末端，使鼓膜振动。

detail.en:
The eardrum is a thin membrane at the inner end of the ear canal. Its movement passes to the malleus, the first of the three middle-ear bones. [S7, S8]

The sloping, shallow membrane vibrates slowly here so its motion can be seen. The shown displacement and timing are illustrative, not measured eardrum movement. [S31]
detail.zh:
鼓膜位于外耳道内端，是一层薄膜。它的运动传给锤骨，即中耳三块听小骨中的第一块。[S7, S8]

这里把浅凹、倾斜的薄膜慢放振动，便于观察。显示的位移与节律只是示意，不是鼓膜运动测量。[S31]

summary.en: The malleus transfers movement from the eardrum to the incus.
summary.zh: 锤骨把鼓膜运动传给砧骨。

detail.en:
The handle of the malleus contacts the eardrum, while its rounded head articulates with the incus. It is one of the three ossicles. [S7, S8]

The head and curved handle are an original simplified outline. The slow rocking motion shows transfer through the connected chain without claiming a real lever gain or biological delay. [S31]
detail.zh:
锤骨的柄与鼓膜接触，圆头与砧骨相接。它是三块听小骨之一。[S7, S8]

圆头与弯柄是原创简化外形。慢速摆动用来说明相连骨链传递运动，不表示真实杠杆增益或生理延迟。[S31]

summary.en: The incus links the malleus to the stapes.
summary.zh: 砧骨连接锤骨与镫骨。

detail.en:
The incus is the middle bone of the ossicle chain. Its body meets the malleus, and its long process reaches the stapes. [S7, S8]

The two processes are kept distinct in this original schematic. The contact at each end is enlarged enough to read; small joints and ligaments are omitted. [S31]
detail.zh:
砧骨位于听小骨链中间，体部与锤骨相接，长突伸向镫骨。[S7, S8]

原创示意保留了可分辨的两个突起。两端接触处放大以便观察，省略细小关节与韧带。[S31]

summary.en: The stapes footplate transfers movement at the oval window.
summary.zh: 镫骨底板在卵圆窗处传递运动。

detail.en:
The stapes receives movement from the incus. Its two limbs join a footplate that rests at the oval window, transferring movement into the inner ear. [S8]

The two crura and single footplate are explicit in this original schematic. The small piston-like movement is illustrative and stays at the window; it is not a spinning bone. [S31]
detail.zh:
镫骨接收砧骨的运动，两条脚连接一块底板，底板位于卵圆窗处，把运动传入内耳。[S8]

原创示意明确画出两脚和一块底板。小幅活塞式运动只作说明，底板保持在窗处；镫骨不会自转。[S31]

summary.en: The oval window is the interface where stapes movement enters the inner ear.
summary.zh: 卵圆窗是镫骨运动传入内耳的界面。

detail.en:
The stapes footplate sits at the oval window. Its movement passes to the fluid-filled inner ear rather than carrying a stream of outside air into the cochlea. [S8]

The thin oval interface and footplate touch in this schematic. Surrounding bone is omitted to expose that relationship; the displayed size is not a measurement. [S31]
detail.zh:
镫骨底板位于卵圆窗处，其运动传到充满液体的内耳，并不是把外界空气不断送进耳蜗。[S8]

薄薄的椭圆界面与底板在示意中相接。为了露出这层关系，周围骨壁被省略；显示尺寸不是测量值。[S31]

summary.en: The Eustachian tube helps equalise pressure across the eardrum.
summary.zh: 咽鼓管帮助平衡鼓膜两侧的气压。

detail.en:
The Eustachian tube connects the middle ear toward the throat and helps equalise pressure. It is not the main route carrying hearing signals to the brain. [S8]

The downward tube is shown only as context. This lesson does not simulate opening, swallowing or pressure changes. [S31]
detail.zh:
咽鼓管连接中耳与咽部方向，帮助平衡气压。它不是把听觉信号传向大脑的主要路径。[S8]

向下的管道只用来定位。本课不模拟管道开放、吞咽或压力变化。[S31]

summary.en: The fluid-filled cochlea contains structures that turn vibration into signals.
summary.zh: 充满液体的耳蜗含有把振动转成信号的结构。

detail.en:
The cochlea is the coiled hearing structure of the inner ear. Movement at the oval window produces motion in its fluid and a travelling wave along the basilar membrane. [S7]

This original open spiral shows a cavity, not a pipe draining water out of the ear. Its turns are schematic, not an exact anatomical turn count. A separate enlarged strip makes the membrane and sensory cells readable. [S31]
detail.zh:
耳蜗是内耳中卷曲的听觉结构。卵圆窗处的运动使内部液体运动，并在基底膜上形成行波。[S7]

原创的开口螺旋显示腔体，不表示水不断排出耳外。圈数是示意，不是精确解剖计数。另一个放大条带用来展示膜与感受细胞。[S31]

summary.en: A travelling wave along the basilar membrane moves nearby sensory structures.
summary.zh: 沿基底膜传播的行波使附近的感受结构运动。

detail.en:
The basilar membrane lies within the cochlea. Cochlear fluid movement sets up a travelling wave along it; different regions respond most strongly to different frequencies. [S7]

This unfolded strip is an enlarged schematic, at a different scale and outside its anatomical position. A single local patch rises and falls as one sample; this is not a simulation of a spatial travelling wave, biological timing or cochlear tuning. [S31]
detail.zh:
基底膜位于耳蜗内部，耳蜗液体的运动在它上面形成行波。不同区域对不同频率的响应较强。[S7]

展开的条带是独立放大示意，比例与原位不同。单个局部膜片作为一个示意样本整体起伏，不模拟空间行波、生理时延或具体的耳蜗调谐曲线。[S31]

summary.en: Bending the tiny bundles helps sensory hair cells start electrical signalling.
summary.zh: 微小纤毛束的弯曲帮助毛细胞启动电信号传递。

detail.en:
Sensory hair cells lie on the cochlear sensory structure. Their tiny hair-like bundles bend during movement and help initiate electrical signalling. These bundles are not ordinary hair. [S7]

The three cells and a few bundle strokes form an enlarged schematic at a different scale. The number drawn is not a total cell count, and the bundles tilt together as a stylised sample rather than deforming each stereocilium. No ion channels or biological delays are calculated. [S31]
detail.zh:
感受毛细胞位于耳蜗的感受结构上，微小的纤毛束在运动中弯曲，帮助启动电信号。纤毛束不是普通毛发。[S7]

这里的三个细胞和少量纤毛笔画是独立比例的放大示意，画出数量不代表细胞总数。纤毛束整体倾斜是风格化样本，不是逐根纤毛的变形模拟，也不计算离子通道或生理时延。[S31]

summary.en: The auditory nerve carries hearing signals toward the brain.
summary.zh: 听神经把听觉信号传向大脑。

detail.en:
The auditory nerve carries electrical signals from the cochlea toward the brain. Outside air particles do not travel along this nerve. [S7]

The tube is a schematic nerve bundle. The signal route connects the enlarged sensory-cell window to this route for teaching; its length and the speed of markers are not biological measurements. [S31]
detail.zh:
听神经把来自耳蜗的电信号传向大脑。外界空气粒子不会沿这条神经传到脑里。[S7]

管状形体表示神经束。为了教学，信号路径把放大的感受细胞窗接向这一通路；路径长度和标记速度都不是生理测量。[S31]

summary.en: Nearby vestibular structures help sense head movement and balance.
summary.zh: 附近的前庭结构帮助感知头部运动与平衡。

detail.en:
The vestibular structures, including the semicircular canals, lie beside the cochlea. They help with balance and are distinct from the hearing pathway taught here. [S8]

Three simplified loops locate this neighbouring system. No balance experiment, fluid response or individual vestibular function is simulated. [S31]
detail.zh:
前庭结构包括半规管，位于耳蜗附近，帮助维持平衡，与这里讲述的听觉通路功能不同。[S8]

三个简化环只用来定位邻近系统，不模拟平衡实验、液体响应或个人前庭功能。[S31]

summary.en: This point marks the upper part of the model object.
summary.zh: 这一点表示模型物体的上部。

detail.en:
The upper point supplies one set of rays to the effective lens. At the receiver its beam centre lies below the optical axis. [S11]

The model height is one model centimetre. This larger point and the smaller lower point make the inversion readable without drawing a photographic image; these are design values, not eye measurements. [S31]
detail.zh:
物体上部的一点向有效透镜提供一组光线；在接收面上，这束光的中心位于光轴下方。[S11]

模型高度为一模型厘米。较大的上点与较小的下点帮助辨认倒立关系，不表示完整照片；这些是设计值，不是眼球测量。[S31]

summary.en: This point marks the lower part of the model object.
summary.zh: 这一点表示模型物体的下部。

detail.en:
The lower point supplies the other three rays in the optical model. Its beam centre reaches the upper part of the receiver. [S11]

Its height is minus half a model centimetre. The two unequal marker sizes belong to the teaching object and do not represent a living structure. [S31]
detail.zh:
模型下部的一点提供另一组三条光线，它的光束中心到达接收面的上部。[S11]

高度为负半模型厘米。两个大小不同的标记只属于教学物体，不表示生物结构。[S31]

summary.en: The fixed receiver shows where the model light bundle arrives.
summary.zh: 固定接收面显示模型光束落在哪里。

detail.en:
This receiver represents the retina in the separate effective-lens model. Light rays terminate at the receiver; a focused point or blur is derived from the same thin-lens geometry as the readouts. [S11]

It stays four model centimetres behind the effective lens. This frame is not a second anatomical retina, and its dimensions are design values rather than human measurements. [S31]
detail.zh:
这一接收面在独立有效透镜模型中代表视网膜。光线到这里为止；清晰点或散开的光斑与读数使用同一套薄透镜几何计算。[S11]

它固定在有效透镜后四模型厘米。线框不是另一层解剖视网膜，尺寸是设计值，不是人体测量。[S31]

summary.en: This marker identifies the start of the hearing-signal route.
summary.zh: 这一标记指出听觉信号通路的起点。

detail.en:
Electrical signalling begins after sensory transduction, rather than being a continuation of incoming light or a stream of outside air. [S2, S7]

The small marker sits beside the enlarged hair-cell window. Moving route markers represent signals only, and their size and speed are chosen for visibility. [S31]
detail.zh:
感受结构转导之后才开始电信号传递；它不是入射光的延续，也不是外界空气流。[S2, S7]

小标记位于放大毛细胞窗旁。路径中的移动标记只表示信号，大小与速度按可见性设计。[S31]

summary.en: The rest mark shows that a medium particle moves locally back and forth.
summary.zh: 静止位置标记显示介质粒子只在附近来回运动。

detail.en:
In a longitudinal sound wave, medium particles move back and forth about their rest positions while the wave pattern travels. A particle does not make the journey from a source to the ear. [S9]

This fixed tick marks the highlighted particle’s rest position. The silent model uses a fixed slowdown factor and relative displacement; it is not a sound-level meter or a hearing test. [S31]
detail.zh:
纵向声波中的介质粒子在静止位置附近往复，而波的形态向前传播。粒子不会从声源一路走到耳朵。[S9]

固定短刻度标出高亮粒子的静止位置。无声模型使用固定慢放倍率与相对位移，不是声级计或听力测试。[S31]

summary.en: This insert shows one model pupil opening.
summary.zh: 这张薄片显示一档模型瞳孔开口。

detail.en: Original schematic annulus with a fixed outer diameter and a control-selected inner aperture. It is non-selectable context belonging to the iris. [S31]
detail.zh: 原创环形示意保持外径不变，由控件选择内孔。这是属于虹膜的不可选中背景件。[S31]

summary.en: This insert shows one model pupil opening.
summary.zh: 这张薄片显示一档模型瞳孔开口。

detail.en: Original schematic annulus with a fixed outer diameter and a control-selected inner aperture. It is non-selectable context belonging to the iris. [S31]
detail.zh: 原创环形示意保持外径不变，由控件选择内孔。这是属于虹膜的不可选中背景件。[S31]

value.zh: 原创示意·各工位比例不同
角膜与晶状体合成一个有效透镜

label.zh: 模型最大位移·场景单位
